question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Q has an exam on Tuesday. Exactly 2 people have exams between Q and R. P has an exam immediately before T, and S has an exam immediately after V. Only 1 person has an exam between T and V. Who has an exam on Monday?
solution:

Total days: 7 (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday)
